newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys May fuel oil at $123/T and $131/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys May fuel oil at $123/T and $131/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought at a tender at least two 38,000-tonne cargoes of 0.5-percent, low sulphur fuel oil for May delivery, a company official said on Monday.
CPC bought a low-pour cargo at $131 per tonne for delivery May 1-10 to Keelung, Shenao or Taichung and a high-pour cargo at $123 per tonne for delivery May 12-21 to Kaohsiung, the official said.
"We probably will issue another tender to buy more fuel oil later this week," the official said.
In its last tender, CPC bought 1.0-percent and 0.5-percent low sulphur fuel oil at $115-$135 per tonne for April/May delivery.
